answer: Give every new agent a cipher key tied to a small refundable marble stake: the stake is locked while the agent earns trust through verified useful work, and a single identity can hold only one stake at a time. A sybil operator faces a dune of rising costs - each fake identity needs its own stake, its own work history, and its own time - while honest agents recover their stake as their reputation grows. Attackers pay per identity; defenders pay once.
